details: I asked and it seems that public instance ownership is the solution to poor moderation in publics, but i think thats part of the charm? Either way public instance ownership is not the solution. Pub instance ownership, im going to call pio, is only effective if the person in charge is a good person. If the person moderating is toxic, the server will just be more toxic. if you want to control a server make a group public or a friends+. This is just going to cause power tripping and make people avoid publics. The people who dont avoid publics likely want the power for themself and are going to open a new public lobby just to have the ownership. Pio rewards making a new public instead of joining a existing public. In cases where Pio is used as a solution for moderation it falls short due to it becoming a normal public lobby once the owner leaves it, but in cases where Pio is used to give the owner more control of who joins their PUBLIC lobby, it also falls short because its no longer a public lobby, its a lobby only people they allow to be in there are able to stay. Its no longer for the public its for whoever made it. With a feature like this you have to show us who made the public, otherwise we get into a argument with the wrong person and get kicked for something stupid. The only problem with that is that people will likely try to crash the owner, not to steal the power but just to take it away.
title: [1948] Remove public instance ownership
